problems.symptom: A producer writes a path, key, table, id or literal that the consumer never reads. The failure is silent (400 swallowed, SCHEMAFULL drop, optional chaining, catch returning empty).
problems.root_cause: No write/read agreement check at the seams. The joint-liveness detector was filed 3+ times and never built; only declarationDrift exists, for the schema slice.

problems.symptom: Gates, oracles and operator instruments certify things that are false: agreement by construction, fail-open guards, vacuous checks, LLM judge inversion, instrument traps.
problems.root_cause: Checks read text, verdicts or the diff instead of running the thing or measuring its effect. Every new gate had a hole that only running it exposed.

problems.symptom: Commits pass every gate but do nothing (stubs, unread headers, dead SELECTs, inert fallbacks, dead code extended).
problems.root_cause: The mitosis and semantic gates verify that code landed and reads plausibly, not that behaviour changed. Most target files have no tests.

problems.symptom: Substrate landings broke production: all writes to activity rejected, cutover deadlock, anchor regression, recursion storm, live-source writes by walk satisfiers.
problems.root_cause: No effect verification or run-time check before landing. Walk satisfiers have no rollback. There is no recursion or depth brake.

problems.symptom: The artifact that runs differs from the one edited or verified: dist vs src, /vessels vs clone vs host, image-baked gen-env, submodule lag, stranded rebase.
problems.root_cause: There are several deploy layers and nothing asserts runtime == committed == origin. Many fixes were verified on the wrong layer.

problems.symptom: DB thrash and OOM, deletes that cannot drain, migrations marked applied without running, SCHEMAFULL silently dropping writes.
problems.root_cause: Unbounded tables and missing indexes, no admission control, a migration runner that bootstraps by marking everything applied, and ExecStartPre=- swallowing failures.

problems.symptom: Lessons reach no reader: concept-db restarted and timing out, dense leg dead, memoryNote has no runtime reader, relevance not counterfactual.
problems.root_cause: The teaching channel shares a degraded vessel. The prescribed counterfactual relevance was implemented as a hit counter. There is no retention lifecycle.

problems.symptom: The compose lane is starved or busy: directed goals time out, the compose host restarts every ~13 min, full test suites push load to 41-57, recommit burns 26% of capacity.
problems.root_cause: No priority between directed and autonomous work, the compose host shares a lifecycle with its own self-edits, verification is external suites, and the growth governor was never built.

problems.symptom: Behaviour differs between hub and spoke: host-local policy, traces only on the hub, dead self-development plane on the hub, unpublished ports, loopback advertisements.
problems.root_cause: State is kept in host files or volumes and discovery advertises loopback addresses. Verification is done on one node.

problems.symptom: Gaps are unactionable (phantom shapes, no edit_site, no falsifier, born closable, false premise).
problems.root_cause: Generators emit goals without checking they route to a real producer. The class-1 guard fails open. About 98% of gaps have no falsifier.

problems.symptom: The drafter fabricates anchors and helpers, halves multi-op goals, writes envelopes into source, and hallucinates member access.
problems.root_cause: Information supply was fixed (anchor band, locators). What remains is adherence, which needs mechanical constraints (pick an index) and one op per goal.

problems.symptom: Credit is mis-assigned: wrong answers alpha-credited, only the floor's wins recorded, compose rows ungraded, UNFAVORABLE beta lost, posteriors measure cost.
problems.root_cause: Graders key on self-reported verdicts, id schemes are disjoint, and the classifiers measure naming conventions.

problems.symptom: Built but never running: 14 autonomy units masked, 11 timers never enabled, 90/102 validators dormant, the rhythm conductor selection-scheduled, the ribosome dormant, the anti-loop guard.
problems.root_cause: Cadence rides on Thompson selection, and the inventory and role groups exclude units. A check is scheduled by the mechanism it exists to recover.

problems.symptom: Operator fixes regressed or inverted behaviour: drain floor, kill switch, retry amplification, blanket clamp, prune, restarts killing measurements.
problems.root_cause: Validation covered only the path being fixed. Sibling guards and other lanes were not tested.

problems.symptom: Recommit and narrowed children, same-id reopens, a goal-hash rejection ratchet, double-applied retries.
problems.root_cause: Retry lanes re-attempt failed work at very low yield, and goal-hash identity accumulates refusals against a gap.

problems.symptom: Behaviour is gated on env vars or EnvironmentFile order: stale keys, WORKSPACE_ROOT, the kill switch, fanout mode, timeouts.
problems.root_cause: Bootstrap config is used for runtime behaviour, and the later EnvironmentFile silently wins.

problems.symptom: Tests and probes write to live stores (memory store, live lease, human journal, deployed tree, live template).
problems.root_cause: Paths frozen at module load, and live state kept in git-tracked or shared locations.

problems.symptom: Duplicate mints, fossil stores, junk commits, orphan temp files, dead tables, vestigial annotations.
problems.root_cause: No retention lifecycle, no placement hook in the container clone, and mints never retired.

problems.symptom: The architecture prescribes activities-as-tests and counterfactual relevance, but the implementation is shadows of both. Log strings lie.
problems.root_cause: The cheaper observational shadow was implemented instead of the prescribed structure.

problems.symptom: 401 cascades after re-key, truncated egress targets, orphan relay squatting the port, loopback identity in bootstrap.
problems.root_cause: Env pins get frozen at container create and image-baked glue drifts.

problems.symptom: The cockpit pointed at a dead hub, discovery /resolve executes a shape instead of listing it, an unauthenticated response reads as '0 producers', resolve envelopes differ between vessels.
problems.root_cause: A dead-plane miss and a real no-producer look the same. Config lives in multiple files.

problems.symptom: Symptom goals don't reach the right file, inference biased to reads, compound goals flattened, write shapes unreachable through the walk.
problems.root_cause: Vocabulary gap between symptoms and identifiers, the example in the inference prompt, and target arity not preserved.

problems.symptom: Human surface push refused, 48 verified cutovers parked, O(PxF) load from test residue.
problems.root_cause: The surface vessel is outside the authorable submodule set, with a local bare remote.

principles: An oracle that generates the artifact it grades is not an oracle; a 'matches by construction' comment is the bug (reference-self-confirming-reach-oracle-maxdepth1-2026-08-04)
When a generator and its grader share a parse, the trace must state the assumptions, never claim independence (reference-self-confirming-oracle-two-dimensions-2026-08-05)

Prove a check fires when the property is violated AND stays quiet when it holds; a gate that fails everything is as useless as one that passes everything (reference-the-build-was-reproducible-on-exactly-one-machine-2026-08-09)
A guard that refuses valid work is only marginally better than one that admits corruption (reference-substrate-landed-its-first-cruft-removal-2026-08-07)
Every gate READS the diff; only a test RUNS it. Pre-register the post-deploy observable in the falsifier (reference-the-authoring-lane-refuses-96-to-99-percent-2026-09-10)
Give the gate a measurement, not an argument. State decisive facts to an LLM judge positively, one claim per sentence (reference-semantic-gate-verdicts-anticorrelated-with-effect-2026-09-04)

Verify the PRODUCER, not the column; git-present != applied; for a DB write the consuming layer is INFO FOR TABLE (reference-selfdev-path-live-diagnosis-2026-08-04; reference-the-audit-field-i-shipped-2026-09-05)
